questions.q: Which tiefling leads the refugees who hold the gate of the druids' grove in Act 1?
Which human adventurer, back from a failed raid on the goblins, quarrels with the tiefling leader at the grove's gate after the fight?
Who leads the goblin war band camped in the ruined temple west of the grove?
choices: Priestess Gut, Dror Ragzlin and Minthara
